start_here: Say to your AI: "What changed at position 4 in my database?" It runs tool:read-one-row-change.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one row of the change table your database already keeps (row_changes, made by workflow:make-a-database-for-each-pursuit).
instructions: 1. Your database records each change of a table you attached record_row_change() to in its row_changes table, and the noticer tells each one as a row-changes fact naming its connection and position.
2. A workflow woken by a change gets the change's row as input.change before its first step: tool:run-workflow-definition runs this tool with the fact's connection and position.

3. To read one yourself, call tools:run with tool tool:read-one-row-change, credential_name (your database connection's vault name) and position. It answers {columns, rows: [{table_name, op, before, after}], row_count}; no other SQL runs.

worked_examples.title: Read the change a lesson request made
worked_examples.ask: What changed at position 4 in my database?
worked_examples.given: A made-up database whose lesson_request table has record_row_change() attached, after one insert (the live walk of 2026-11-18 inserted such a row at position 4).
